acceptance_criteria.criterion: After modifying any file under mcp-server/src/, the next ./menu.sh invocation auto-rebuilds mcp-server/dist/ before presenting the menu.
After modifying any file under ../cli-menu/src/, the next ./menu.sh invocation auto-rebuilds ../cli-menu/dist/.
When ../cli-menu directory does not exist, bootstrap prints the exact git clone command for that repository.
When ../ai-persona-builder directory does not exist, bootstrap prints the exact git clone command for that repository.
Staleness detection uses mtime comparison only — no subprocess is spawned solely for the check.
No changes to menu.sh or menu.cmd are required.

Added missing-repo guidance: prints exact git clone commands for cli-menu and ai-persona-builder when directories absent.
No changes to menu.sh or menu.cmd required (AC-6). Bootstrap smoke test confirmed all staleness triggers working.
